templates.title: Document templates
templates.emptyBody: Templates you create appear here, grouped by document kind.

editor.bodyHint: Use the Insert automatic data buttons below for parts filled in when the document is issued.
editor.noPlaceholders: This template uses no automatic data yet.
editor.knownPlaceholdersEmpty: The system has no automatic data for this document kind yet. Text in curly braces prints as written.
editor.previewHint: Uses sample values and renders in a frame isolated from this page.
editor.kindFixedHint: The document kind cannot change once the template exists.
editor.unknownPlaceholdersHint: Data marked Unknown is not recognised for this kind and prints as written.
editor.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted, or the address is wrong.
editor.previewEmpty: The preview appears once the template body is filled in

templates.description: The templates used when the school issues letters and documents. One template per kind is the default.
